decisions.reason: Publisher URL with /doi/10.1108/QRJ-D-18-00004 path inside a plain-text <ref> (guide 3.5: URL row, whole URL is quoted; role identifier_link). The URL ends at ";" in the source. The DOI is 10.1108/QRJ-D-18-00004, lower-cased to the key. The trailing /full/html is the Emerald view path (Emerald canonical URLs take this form), not part of the DOI; the guide allows a null key only when one cannot tell where the DOI ends, and here it can be told. Engine missed it. Locked label correct.
